findings.claim: An unrelated serializer change rides along with this generator fix. Removing the `case <= byte.MaxValue` branch changes the wire format: integer values 128..255 that used to be written as uint8 (0xcc, 2 bytes) now fall through to TryWriteUInt16 (0xcd, 3 bytes). The output is no longer the smallest encoding the MessagePack spec asks for, and it differs byte-for-byte from what the same values serialized to before. REQ-2283 asks for nothing in the serializer runtime.

findings.claim: The reporter names three unguarded `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` sites inside GetObjectInfo (reported lines 735, 1009 and 1101). findings.claim: The reportDiagnostic wrapper drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a source tree of this compilation, including Location.None, and not only diagnostics about metadata symbols. GetPropertyIdentifierLocation returns null when the declaring syntax is not a PropertyDeclarationSyntax, such as a positional record parameter `[property: Key(...)]` in the compiling assembly. So the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic for such a source-declared member is now silently suppressed instead of reported. L12 only sanctions missing diagnostics for types from referenced assemblies.
